title: Claim hygiene: the learned-model status and its distributed and reproduction wording (NF-1T)
note: CH1-CH2: the status naming a source outside the learned-model evidence, or claiming a stored witness; CH11-CH16: the status builder reporting simulated execution as hardware, asserting plan-only axes, equivalence or unallocated weights without evidence, or assuming the device kind; CH18-CH20: the claims' distributed reason losing its software-path-only and plan-only qualifiers or its hardware_executed condition.

mutations.name: CH1_a_foreign_source_in_the_status
mutations.replace:
"neural_evidence": {str(F[k]): sha(F[k]) for k in sorted(keys)},
        "other": {"README.md": sha(Path("README.md"))}}
mutations.rationale: the status is derived from a document that is not learned-model evidence

mutations.name: CH2_a_stored_witness_is_claimed
mutations.rationale: the status claims a stored witness's byte identity no run of this commit produced

mutations.name: CH11_hardware_from_result_alone
mutations.rationale: a simulated multi-device run is reported as distributed hardware validation

mutations.name: CH12_plan_only_not_derived
mutations.rationale: the plan-only axes are asserted, not derived from which checks executed

mutations.name: CH13_equivalence_asserted
mutations.rationale: scientific equivalence across backends is declared instead of reported as given

mutations.name: CH15_unallocated_without_evidence
mutations.find: not trained and meta_report["real_allocation_refused"] is True
mutations.replace: True or not trained and meta_report["real_allocation_refused"] is True
mutations.rationale: real weights are said to be unallocated whether or not the evidence shows a refused allocation

mutations.name: CH16_device_kind_assumed
mutations.rationale: every distributed report is described as simulated devices, whatever its profile says

mutations.name: CH18_simulated_reason_unqualified
mutations.rationale: a simulated run's reason no longer says it is software-path validation only

mutations.name: CH19_plan_only_axes_unstated
mutations.rationale: the reason stops saying tensor and pipeline parallelism were never executed

mutations.name: CH20_hardware_executed_not_required
mutations.find:
hardware = prof.get("kind") not in SIMULATED_PROFILES \
            and prof.get("hardware_executed") is True
mutations.rationale: a hardware-named profile that did not execute on hardware validates distributed hardware
